prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, new_flow] Sign In Interactive Account Selection Flow: Add an interactive choice card flow on the sign_in screen allowing users to choose explicitly between cloud pet backup and quick guest mode.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select Account Sync Mode", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Adoption Certificate Interactive Naming and Stamp Flow: Introduce an interactive certificate stamp customization flow on the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Choose official certificate stamp", "style": "playful"}], "replace": {"certificate": [{"role": "certificate", "type": "badge", "label": "Official Adoption Certificate Stamp", "style": "emphasis"}]}}}
2: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Story Scroll Layout Redesign: Redesign the choose path screen with a story_scroll layout to guide users seamlessly through path selection.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Choose Your Companion Journey"}}
3: [choose_path, new_screen] Add New Path Selection Overview Screen: Add a new path summary screen before path selection to clearly contrast preset pets versus custom pet creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_path_overview", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_path_overview": {"headline": "Select Your Pet Experience", "body": "Choose between adopting a preset friend or creating a custom desktop pet."}}
4: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Desktop Habitat Notification Alert: Enable desktop notification alerts on the waiting screen to inform users when their desktop habitat is ready.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Desktop habitat preparation in progress."}}
5: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Spotlight Layout Refresh: Update the initial story screen layout to spotlight mode to focus attention on the app's companion concept.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Companion"}}
6: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Compact Stage Layout Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a compact stage layout with dynamic visual preview components.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "compact", "components": [{"type": "preview", "text": "Pet Live Preview", "style": "playful"}]}}
7: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Stage Progress Status Display: Add explicit stage progress indicators and step counter displays to the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_step_counter": true}}
8: [adoption, layout] Upload Photos Two Column Layout Refresh: Refresh the photo upload screen into a two-column layout separating instructions from the photo preview area.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Upload Pet Photos"}}
9: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Existing Pet Account Recovery Copy Refresh: Rewrite sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly assure users that signing in syncs and restores existing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Restore Your Pets", "body": "Log into your account to access your saved pets and keep your desktop companions synced across devices."}}
